entries.femaleVariant: V, I got a job for you. There's a man in Kabuki. The Tyger Claws took him last night.
entries.maleVariant: V, I got a job for you. There's a man in Kabuki. The Tyger Claws took him last night.

entries.femaleVariant: Reynaldo Manalo. He cleaned rooms on an Orbital Air station. They charged him for the flight up, the bed he slept in, even the scraps of food he ate.
entries.maleVariant: Reynaldo Manalo. He cleaned rooms on an Orbital Air station. They charged him for the flight up, the bed he slept in, even the scraps of food he ate.

entries.femaleVariant: After seven years of painful work, he owed more than the day he signed up. So he ran.
entries.maleVariant: After seven years of painful work, he owed more than the day he signed up. So he ran.

entries.femaleVariant: An old friend of mine, Liban, got him down to Night City. Somebody here sold him out.
entries.maleVariant: An old friend of mine, Liban, got him down to Night City. Somebody here sold him out.

entries.femaleVariant: Nobody knows. They took him from his sister's stall in the market.
entries.maleVariant: Nobody knows. They took him from his sister's stall in the market.

entries.femaleVariant: My friend sent his sister to me. She's the client. Talk to her. Details attached.
entries.maleVariant: My friend sent his sister to me. She's the client. Talk to her. Details attached.

entries.femaleVariant: His sister called. He's out of Night City.

entries.maleVariant: Maricel Manalo?

entries.femaleVariant: Ay, Liban said she'd send somebody. Don't talk so loud.
entries.maleVariant: Ay, Liban said she'd send somebody. Don't talk so loud.

entries.femaleVariant: Reynaldo, Rey, is my brother. He came here three nights ago. I hadn't seen him in seven years.
entries.maleVariant: Reynaldo, Rey, is my brother. He came here three nights ago. I hadn't seen him in seven years.

entries.femaleVariant: Two Tyger Claws came last night. They knew his name. They took him out the back.
entries.maleVariant: Two Tyger Claws came last night. They knew his name. They took him out the back.

entries.femaleVariant: Only three people knew he was here. Me, Liban, and a man called Stamps.
entries.maleVariant: Only three people knew he was here. Me, Liban, and a man called Stamps.

entries.femaleVariant: Stamps sells new identities. Rey went to him for one. Ask him who else he told.
entries.maleVariant: Stamps sells new identities. Rey went to him for one. Ask him who else he told.

entries.femaleVariant: He's always on a couch in the alley behind the market.
entries.maleVariant: He's always on a couch in the alley behind the market.

entries.femaleVariant: Looking for the janitor.
entries.maleVariant: Looking for the janitor.

entries.femaleVariant: Ah, the janitor. He wanted a new name.
entries.maleVariant: Ah, the janitor. He wanted a new name.

entries.femaleVariant: I ask everybody who they're running from. He said Orbital Air. Orbital Air paid better for a tip.
entries.maleVariant: I ask everybody who they're running from. He said Orbital Air. Orbital Air paid better for a tip.

entries.femaleVariant: They paid me already. I got nothing to lose telling you. But I don't tell for free.

entries.femaleVariant: Then I'll beat it out of you.
